description: This file defines a generic ApiResponse record used as a standard response envelope for API responses within the microservice, including static methods to easily generate success and error responses.

classes.name: ApiResponse
classes.description: A generic record used as a standard response wrapper in API responses, containing success status, message, and payload.

methods.name: ok
methods.description: Creates a successful ApiResponse with data.

methods.name: ok
methods.description: Creates a successful ApiResponse with message and data.

methods.name: error
